title: Fourier norm of a junta
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $h$ be a sign-valued function on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. If $h$ depends only on some set of at most $k$ coordinates, then the Fourier one-norm of its real-valued sign representation is at most $2^{k/2}$.
hypotheses_covered: $h$ depends only on a set of at most $k$ coordinates
